newsitem.title: CANADA: Production unaffected by fire at Vitol Canada unit.
newsitem.headline: Production unaffected by fire at Vitol Canada unit.

text.p: An early morning fire on Wednesday at North Atlantic Refining Ltd 's Come by Chance oil, Newfoundland refinery damaged equipment, but was not affecting production, company president Ed Mills said.

The fire began when naptha leaking from a platform rehydrogenating unit ignited from a crack in a drainage pipe, Mills said. One worker was sent to the hospital after inhaling fumes, but Mills described his injuries as minor.
The damaged unit would be repaired within days, he said.
North Atlantic Refining, a subsidiary of Dutch trader Vitol, was operating near peak production of 100,000 barrels a day, Mills said.

Damage to the refinery today would have no effect on plans to maintain production without any scheduled down time this year, he said. In previous years the refinery was closed for weeks at a time for upgrades to plant equipment.
